{"id":1965446535,"question_id":2846,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"3 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1775015594,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1965446535/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Robot Collisions","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ti = tuple<int,int,char>;\n\n    vector<int> survivedRobotsHealths(vector<int>& positions, vector<int>& healths, string directions) {\n        vector<ti>info;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<positions.size() ; i++) info.push_back({positions[i] , healths[i] , directions[i]});\n\n        sort(begin(info), end(info));\n\n        stack<ti>st;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<info.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            auto[pos , health , dir] = info[i];\n\n            while(!st.empty() and get<2>(st.top()) == 'R' and dir == 'L')\n            {\n                auto[tpos , thealth , tdir] = st.top();\n                st.pop();\n\n                if(health == thealth) \n                {\n                    health = 0;\n                    break;\n                }\n                else if(thealth > health)\n                {\n                    thealth--;\n                    st.push({tpos , thealth , tdir});\n                    health = 0;\n                    break;\n                }\n                else health--;\n            }\n\n            if(health > 0) st.push({pos , health , dir});\n        }\n\n    vector<int>ans;\n    while(!st.empty())\n    {\n        auto [pos , health , dir] = st.top();\n        st.pop();\n\n        ans.push_back(health);\n    }\n    return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"robot-collisions","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1894}
